info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Relationship Retrieval API
info.description: The Corporate Relationship Retrieval API allows organizations to access detailed information about corporate relationships within their banking systems. By utilizing this API, users can retrieve specific corporate relationship data by providing the appropriate parameters. This functionality is essential for financial institutions and businesses that need to analyze or manage their corporate connections. Typical consumers include banking professionals and financial analysts monitoring corporate interactions and partnerships.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific corporate relationship using its unique identifier. This operation allows users to access relevant information regarding the corporate relationship, making it easier to manage and analyze relationships with corporate entities.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to a specific corporate relationship identified by the unique resource ID 'RES-100045'.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the corporate relationship data.

GetCorporateRelationshipByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on corporate relationships. It provides a string input necessary for the request.
